record.bible_text: And it came to pass, when Solomon<WH08010> had finished<WH03615><WTH8763> the building<WH01129><WTH8800> of the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068>, and the king's<WH04428> house<WH01004>, and all Solomon's<WH08010> desire<WH02837> which he was pleased<WH02654><WTH8804> to do<WH06213><WTH8800>,
